Turn a draft of sliced cards into parking cards: assigns the next numbers free in the parking and among the pull requests and issues --taken lists, marks what the retelling left unclear, and checks every card with the parking grammar before writing; the CLI runs no gh and no model (construct intake v<version>)

USAGE construct intake [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

                --plain    No colors, no lore (CI-friendly) (Default: false)                                                                                                          
               --johnny    Wake up, Netrunner. (Default: false)                                                                                                                       
        --draft=<draft>    JSON file of the sliced cards ({ "cards": [ … ] }), or - for stdin                                                                                         
        --taken=<taken>    File of the pull request and issue numbers already taken, whitespace-separated, or - for stdin                                                             
        --admit=<admit>    A card already parked (<parking>/<id>.md): check it by facts and record it in the bus a caller wires in; no new number                                     
        --amend=<amend>    An admitted card (#<id>) to edit in the bus by the flags below: the checks of --admit, then a card.admitted with source amend; no file                     
    --touches=<touches>    With --amend: +<path> adds a touch, -<path> removes one; several comma-separated                                                                           
    --creates=<creates>    With --amend: +<path> adds a creates entry, -<path> removes one; several comma-separated                                                                   
          --note=<note>    With --amend: a line appended to the card body                                                                                                             
    --witness=<witness>    With --amend: <old witness>=<new witness>, replacing one witness; a weaker one waits for the owner as under --admit                                        
            --who=<who>    With --amend: who takes the card, shift or window                                                                                                          
  --priority=<priority>    With --amend: the owner order of the card, p0, p1 or p2; none clears it, and an amend without it keeps the priority the card has                           
          --move=<move>    A parked card (#<id>) to move to the parking directory --to names: found in the parking root or a direct subdirectory, the file unchanged, the bus holds it
              --to=<to>    With --move: the target parking directory, a subdirectory of the parking root (created when missing) or . for the root                                     
    --parking=<parking>    The parking directory the cards are written to (default: ~/.construct/parking)                                                                             
            --dir=<dir>    Target directory (Default: .)                                                                                                                              
               --dryRun    Print the cards, write nothing (Default: false)                                                                                                            
    --confirm=<confirm>    Park cards whose corrections a person has seen: the token the run that held them printed                                                                   
          --autoConfirm    Accept corrections in advance: park at once and record each card and its corrections in the bus a caller wires in (Default: false)
